name: GTE Base English v1.5
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (NewModel), full attention, no causal mask
notes: Encoder: kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 0, KV formula does not apply. Same parameter count as bge-base-en-v1.5 (109M) — both are BERT-base geometry (hidden 768, 12 layers, intermediate 3072). Key difference: max_position_embeddings 8192 vs BGE's 512, using RoPE with NTK scaling. This is the model that showed Alibaba's GTE family could match BGE on retrieval while supporting longer context. Vocab 30528 (6 more than BERT's 30522). pack_qkv true. MIT license. GGUF and ONNX ports exist.
